title: Dedication
text: For my readers… I know the cold floor where the shattered things belong, I was once that wreckage, scattered and gone. I was the mosaic, glued blind in the dark, Put back together wrong, missing the spark. But I burned down that ruin to build something new, A fortress of bone that the dark can’t get through. Here! Take this fragment of the truth I have found, To help you rise whole from the blood on the ground. Take it and mend what was broken by blight, Until every piece fits you, finally, just right.
